author: Bhargav Bhatt and Peter Scholze
title: Prismatic F-crystals and crystalline Galois representations
statement_used: Integral crystalline representations are equivalent to prismatic F-crystals. The rational crystal at the Hodge–Tate divisor is built by replacing the ordinary de Rham lattice by the degree-zero tensor filtration.
dictionary: Evaluate on the cyclotomic prism of K′, then at its map to the Fontaine prism. O acts by full faithfulness.
At a primitive root the pullback divisor is disjoint after inverting p. The Frobenius source is therefore ordinary, and a labelled target jump u changes the lattice by t^(−u).
At level one use crystalline base change from K₀ for the tame action.
retrieval_status: Journal version, Theorem 5.6 and Construction 6.5 with the proof in §6.4.
exact_dictionary_location: The proof paragraphs recorded for WCC1, WCC5, WCC7 in this component’s claims.json.
not_claimed: The integral lower-root division and both power-series transition bounds are proved in this manuscript.

author: Zhiyou Wu
title: Galois representations, (φ,Γ)-modules and prismatic F-crystals
statement_used: The completed étale prismatic evaluation is the cyclotomic (φ,Γ)-module, with the original representation obtained over the perfect Witt target.
dictionary: The ground field K′ is totally ramified over W(k′)[1/p] and uses the same tail of the cyclotomic tower.
The shift on the perfect Witt target sends the depth-s coordinate to the Fontaine prism and transports the unramified labels.
retrieval_status: Publisher PDF, Example 3.4, Theorem 5.2 and Corollary 5.8.
exact_dictionary_location: The proof paragraphs recorded for WCC1 in this component’s claims.json.
not_claimed: Bounds at lower and primitive cyclotomic roots.

author: Jean-Marc Fontaine
title: Représentations p-adiques des corps locaux (1ère partie)
locators: §A3.4, Remarques 3.4.4(b), compatibility of the cyclotomic module with the base field
statement_used: The integral cyclotomic étale functor is an equivalence on continuous representations on finitely generated integral modules, including torsion. Its full faithfulness identifies morphisms commuting with Frobenius and the full cyclotomic action with equivariant maps of representations.
dictionary: Apply the exact functor to the kernel sequence of the residue quotient, retaining the O-action by functoriality.
Project by the unramified embedding idempotent and average over the finite tame group.
Send the unit to a fixed vector tuple and recover a coefficient-linear Galois map by full faithfulness.
retrieval_status: The indicated theorem and its domain were checked in the linked text.
exact_dictionary_location: WCC8, reduction and tame invariants on the level-one lattice.
not_claimed: The bound on Selmer orders as the twist varies is a separate arithmetic problem.

author: Laurent Berger
title: Limites de représentations cristallines
locators: Author’s errata, section 2, on the rational definition
statement_used: A stable lattice in a crystalline representation over an unramified field has an integral Wach lattice with trivial cyclotomic action modulo the parameter.
dictionary: Start over the unramified field and restrict at level one. WCC1 identifies the étale base change and WCC7 constructs the fixed component basis.
The tame average preserves the reduction of a basis and applies only to a group of order p−1.
